top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Bealach Mór (The Bà Sportive)'s demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.

Road-specific control matters at Bealach Mór (The Bà Sportive). Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 44 miles.
At Bealach Mór (The Bà Sportive), changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
59ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Bealach Mór (The Bà Sportive). Train it until it feels boring.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Bealach Mór (The Bà Sportive). Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
44 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Torque for headwinds and mixed terrain. When cadence drops below 70rpm, muscular strength keeps the watts up.
Base fitness for Bealach Mór (The Bà Sportive). Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Bealach Mór (The Bà Sportive). Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Bealach Mór (The Bà Sportive) rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.
